km-eat-59._source: Transcribed from Fatamorgana's own image-only PDF menu (winter 2026 edition), rendered page-by-page. Bilingual PL/EN in the original. The card ROTATES SEASONALLY — dishes turn over; the drinks and the two Łódź signatures (zalewajka, prażoki) are the stable core. 10% service charge on parties of 5+.

km-eat-2._source: ⚠️ NO PRICES, deliberately. Every dish is one Polish sources name for the ŁÓDŹ venue, but no Łódź price could be verified — and two decoy sites would have supplied fake ones: notosushi.pl is an unrelated Kraków vending-machine chain, notosushi.com is the Zielona Góra branch. Another city's prices must never be attributed to this pin. Sources agree only on a range: rolls from ~12 zł to just under 40 zł.
